title: Software modification - Vaporize existing work intake

stateResults.summary: The operator explicitly authorized preserving and committing existing work, including old work.
The standalone Vaporize repository contained 56 pre-existing dirty paths; all 45 JSON records decode and no dirty file reaches 100 MiB.

The focused Windows build exposed three test defects, each captured as a closed error Bead and repaired. VaporizeI18nSourceGatePreflightTests then passed 5/5; the resolved graph points at controlled local Swift Log, Swift Configuration, Swift Service Lifecycle, and Swift NIO Extras paths without identity warnings.
Validated source, documentation, generated evidence, and lockfile slices are being emitted as separate exact-file Savepoints.

notes: The pre-existing work is not attributed to Codex merely because Codex validates and persists it.
The SwiftPM duplicate-identity warning was corrected at its wrkstrm-upstreams ownership boundaries and the consumer graph was revalidated.
No parent Swift Universal gitlink advancement or push is included.
